// probe decodes each book file named on the command line with lib's types-mode decoder and
// with app's data parser (the file's .data twin), printing one verdict line each
// (TestRefDependentRoundTrip, DECISIONS 350).
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import * as app from "./app.js";
import * as lib from "./lib.js";

function show(p) {
  return p === null ? "none" : p.branch + ":" + String(p.value);
}

function entry(e) {
  return [
    "kind=" + e.kind, "payload=" + show(e.payload), "more=[" + e.more.map(show).join(",") + "]",
    "ev=" + e.ev, "byEv=" + show(e.byEv),
    "num=" + String(e.num), "byNum=" + show(e.byNum),
    "flag=" + e.flag, "byFlag=" + show(e.byFlag),
    "alias=" + e.alias, "byAlias=" + show(e.byAlias),
  ].join(" ");
}

function verdict(read) {
  let b;
  try {
    b = read();
  } catch (e) {
    return String(e.message).includes("no branch for this value") ? "error no branch" : "error other";
  }
  return "ok " + b.entries.map(entry).join("; ");
}

for (const path of process.argv.slice(2)) {
  const text = readFileSync(path, "utf8");
  console.log("ts-types " + verdict(() => lib.decodeBook(JSON.parse(text))));
  const data = readFileSync(path + ".data", "utf8");
  console.log("ts-data " + verdict(() => app.parseBook(data)));
}
